scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.labs.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.postinstall: wrangler types --strict-vars=false src/server/worker-configuration.d.ts >/dev/null && wrangler types --strict-vars=false --config labs/square/wrangler.jsonc labs/square/src/worker-configuration.d.ts >/dev/null
scripts.lab:square:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config labs/square/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config labs/square/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lab:square:deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config labs/square/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config labs/square/wrangler.jsonc
